d: The iPhone 18 Pro is all about more control in photo, video, and editing. Verge’s senior reviewer, Allison Johnson, takes a closer look at the iPhone 18 Pro’s new variable-aperture main camera, manual controls, and AI editing tools in Apple’s latest iPhone. The 6.3-inch iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, which is $100 more than last year’s phone. The 6.9-inch iPhone 18 Pro Max goes up to $1,299, another $100 jump. Both phones will launch Sept. 18
